propositions: close_ticket commits the STATUS event and releases the lock before the signing tail runs, allowing a transient lock timeout in sign_completion_verdict to raise SigningError 60s after the close has durably committed
SigningError is caught and only logged to stderr with exit code 0, returning the normal success payload with no field indicating the signature failure, making the loss undetectable to callers

A completion_signature field {signed, cause, error} must be added to the close_ticket return payload with machine-readable cause values (signed, sign_failed, material_drifted, force_bypassed) and threaded through all three public surfaces
The cause field must be absent from non-close transitions and from idea→closed transitions, as those are not completions and should not invent a signature outcome
The stderr message must state the close landed and only the signature failed, not present the lock error as the close failing, to avoid misleading callers into re-running the transition
Exit code must remain 0 per the frozen exit-codes.md contract; a new code is a release decision outside scope and reusing exit 1 would cause agents to re-run an already-closed transition
